FN-3PUC4VV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 605
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/16/2026
House Bill 605 as introduced would increase the administrative costs of the State Health
Planning and Development Agency by a small, undetermined amount to: (1) issue and renew
certificates to entities that carry out the state's policy regarding rural healthcare provided in this
bill; and (2) to adopt rules that provide for the ongoing and active supervision of the entities that
have been certified.
